items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: He's right down St. Gloria Street, old man Shao Ney. He learned white and colored too. ... He was a good old teacher. ... First piece of music I learned how to play ... with him.

ctx.x: Well, how come you started to take off the music?
Well, I took it up with old man Shao Ney on St. Gloria.
